notes: Machine-readable counterpart to the governed Delaney Hall primary-record intake queue. Missing records block promotion but do not predetermine factual or constitutional outcomes.

items.record_class: Original TRT World post, caption, posting time, durable URL, and underlying camera file
items.activation_effect: Blocks complete media provenance and continuous-event reconstruction.
items.notes: Original publication and underlying source file required.

items.record_class: Full unedited footage before and after each visible restraint, baton, and chemical-agent event
items.activation_effect: Blocks individualized necessity and proportionality findings.
items.notes: Edited social-media footage is insufficient for continuous chronology.

items.record_class: Audio, dispatch, radio, warning, and dispersal-order records
items.activation_effect: Blocks findings about notice, compliance opportunity, command authority, and de-escalation.
items.notes: Commands must be tied to time, issuer, audibility, exit route, and compliance window.

items.record_class: Arrest affidavits, charging records, probable-cause statements, and dispositions
items.notes: Must be individualized by arrested person.

items.record_class: Body-worn camera, facility surveillance, vehicle-camera, and perimeter-camera footage
items.activation_effect: Blocks independent reconstruction of each force event.
items.notes: Preservation and completeness records are also required.

items.record_class: Exact DHS, ICE, or ERO use-of-force, chemical-agent, baton, crowd-control, reporting, intervention, and medical-aid policies in effect on May 26, 2026
items.activation_effect: Blocks component-policy compliance analysis; DOJ policy remains only a benchmark.
items.notes: Policy version and effective date must be confirmed.

items.record_class: Incident reports and force reports identifying personnel, force type, justification, duration, injuries, intervention, and medical response
items.activation_effect: Blocks event-specific official reconstruction and contradiction testing.
items.notes: Must preserve original and amended versions.

items.record_class: Facility access, inspection, food, sanitation, temperature, grievance, and medical records
items.activation_effect: Blocks resolution of conflicting conditions claims.
items.notes: Independent inspection records are preferred where available.

items.record_class: Hunger and labor strike declarations, demands, dates, medical monitoring, and facility responses
items.activation_effect: Blocks measurement of strike scope, duration, and consequences.
items.notes: Participant identities require safety and privacy protections.

items.record_class: Transfer order, destination, reason, notice, legal continuity, medical continuity, and retaliation review for the reported organizer transfer
items.activation_effect: Blocks determination whether the transfer was lawful administration, necessity, or retaliation.
items.notes: Use lawful, privacy-preserving receipts or de-identified findings.

items.record_class: Individual detention, custody-review, removal-order, stay, appeal, habeas, counsel-access, and identity records
items.notes: No public inference may be made from sealed or unavailable records.

items.record_class: Medical treatment and injury records for protesters, officers, observers, journalists, elected officials, and detainees
Complaints, internal investigations, inspector-general referrals, civil-rights reviews, and disciplinary outcomes
items.notes: Open and closed review status should be distinguished.

items.record_class: Federal exterior operations plan and command structure
items.activation_effect: Blocks identification of who authorized escalation, force tools, transfer protection, and withdrawal.
items.notes: Operational-security redactions must not erase authority and accountability fields.

items.record_class: New Jersey State Police exterior operations plan, protest-zone maps, checkpoint rules, warnings, arrests, force, injuries, and complaints
items.activation_effect: Blocks completion of the federal-to-state operational control.
items.notes: Comparable measures must use the same definitions and time windows.

items.record_class: Comparable federal detention-protest incidents under prior administrations
items.notes: Controls must match facility type, protest conduct, enforcement tools, and legal posture.

items.record_class: Press and observer declarations, original images, credentials, location data, and arrest or force records
items.activation_effect: Blocks individualized findings concerning press, observer, or mediator treatment.
items.notes: Protected observation does not immunize unlawful conduct, and crowd misconduct does not transfer to observers.

items.record_class: Statements, recordings, or records from Senator Andy Kim and other elected officials present
items.activation_effect: Blocks full reconstruction of mediation, warning, oversight, and chemical-exposure claims.
items.notes: Primary statements and recordings preferred over summaries.
